heading: INT. CASINO BOAT - COUNTING ROOM - NIGHT

units.text: INT. CASINO BOAT - COUNTING ROOM - NIGHT
A windowless steel room that rocks faintly with the river.
Money cages, bins of chips, a long table piled with banded cash.
A brass clock ticks too loudly.
SAUL VERDUGO, sixties, the pit boss, sits at the head of the table with his hands flat.
Facing him are MARISOL TREJO, thirties, with a leather folio; BAXTER KWAN, forties, in a damp raincoat; and DESMOND "DEZ" MOURAD, fifty, whose jacket hangs open to show a holster.
At the cage, a cashier, LUCILLE FONTAINE, forties, has frozen with a stack of twenties in her hand.
In the corner by the door, a boy, GABRIEL VERDUGO, sixteen, holds a mop and says nothing.
Count it again.
units.name: SAUL

units.text: We counted it twice.
units.name: MARISOL

units.text: Then a third time won't hurt.
units.name: SAUL

units.text: It's short two hundred thousand. You can count until the boat sinks.
units.name: BAXTER

units.text: The boat is not going to sink, Mr. Kwan.
units.name: SAUL

units.text: Somebody in this room is lying.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: Somebody on this boat is lying.
units.name: MARISOL

units.text: That's what I said.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: No, it isn't. You said this room. This room has six people in it, one of them a child.
units.name: SAUL

units.text: I'm sixteen.
units.name: GABRIEL

units.text: You're a child.
units.name: SAUL

units.text: The boy doesn't count.
units.name: BAXTER

units.text: Everyone counts. That's the point.
units.name: MARISOL

units.text: Then let's start with the cage.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: Don't look at me.
units.name: LUCILLE

units.text: I'm looking at everyone.
units.name: DEZ

units.text: Lucille, put down the money.
units.name: SAUL

units.text: Lucille sets the stack on the counter.
Dez rises.
Baxter rises.
Marisol closes her folio.
Saul lifts one hand, and the others stop where they stand.
Sit down. All of you. Sit down and we will do this like family.
units.name: SAUL

units.text: Gabriel drops the mop.
The clatter makes every head turn.
Dez's hand goes to the holster.
Lucille ducks behind the cage.
Baxter backs against the wall.
Marisol does not flinch.
Saul looks at his grandson, and the old man's face goes slack.
